groups.defect: Imported posts interpolate unescaped URLs into the attribution footer and render external HTML without sanitization.
groups.rationale: All three report the same footer URL injection. The first two additionally report unsanitized imported content, so the merged comment must preserve both defects.

groups.defect: The embed layout interpolates the Referer header into a JavaScript string without JavaScript-context escaping.
groups.rationale: Both report script injection through the same postMessage target argument; their example payloads and suggested escaping methods differ.

groups.defect: The dangling `if` in `<%- end if %>` makes the embed template invalid Ruby.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same template syntax error at line 6 and propose the same correction.

groups.defect: Feed imports abort on missing item content; the broader report also identifies unsupported String#scrub calls on older Ruby versions and missing titles causing insert failures.
groups.rationale: Both report the unconditional i.content.scrub call failing for content-less items. The first also reports Ruby-version compatibility and missing-title defects that must survive consolidation.
